collection.profileNotice: Unofficial fan-fiction demo data. Rick and Morty character names and portraits belong to their respective rights holders; portrait metadata is sourced from The Rick and Morty API.

characters.bio: C-137 scientist, portal traveler, garage inventor, and reluctant family problem-solver. Usually has a shortcut; rarely has a safety briefing.
Adventure partner, increasingly skeptical grandson, and frequent author of risk reviews that should have happened before the portal opened.
Older sister, sharp observer, and the person most likely to keep a collapsing family operation moving while everyone else argues.
Horse surgeon, mother, Rick's daughter, and expert at asking the one family question nobody in the room wants to answer.
Dad, occasional advertising professional, bee enthusiast, and persistent believer that a clear label can solve almost anything.
Galactic resistance fighter and Beth variant. The Rick and Morty API catalogs this armored clone as Defiance Beth.
Warrior of Bird World, longtime friend of Rick, and a patient observer of human social rituals.
Family therapist interested in behavior, accountability, and the extraordinary work people do to avoid ordinary emotional maintenance.
Citadel politician, systems thinker, and determined critic of any multiverse whose boundaries were drawn by Ricks.
Highly capable operative, devoted father, and survivor of one unusually resourceful pickle-shaped ally.
Cronenberg-dimension survivor. Resourceful, protective, and no longer interested in taking portal travelers at their word.
A C-137 Jessica altered by the love-potion disaster. Profile maintained as an incident record for the survivors' network.
Student, occasional adventure witness, and—according to the API's latest record—a human Time God from the replacement dimension.
Task-oriented helper from a Meeseeks Box. Strong preference for measurable goals, realistic scope, and short engagements.
Longtime family friend, relentlessly upbeat correspondent, and survivor of the Smith household's memory-parasite screening process.
A one-episode Rick configuration: pickle body, improvised exoskeleton, complete confidence, and a conspicuous scheduling conflict with therapy.
Archived memory-parasite persona associated with Total Rickall. Status is dead; profile retained for deterministic episode fixtures.
Cat-person from Planet Squanch, party host, musician, and loyal friend to Rick and Birdperson.
Original C-137 Summer and survivor of the love-potion outbreak. Direct, practical, and protective of the remaining family.
President of the United States, defender of federal jurisdiction, and recurring rival for Rick's attention and credit.
Collective alien intelligence with planetary-scale coordination experience and a complicated history with Rick.
Original C-137 Beth and survivor of Rick Potion #9. Keeps the family alive and the survivor camp functioning.

communities.description: Family updates, portal etiquette, interdimensional incident reports, and arguments that were too loud for the garage.

communities.name: memory_parasites
communities.description: Bad-memory verification, quarantine notes, recovery updates, and respectful discussion of the Total Rickall incident.

communities.name: pickle_rick
communities.description: Improvised engineering, sewer survival, family therapy follow-ups, and one highly specific transformation.

communities.name: tales_from_citadel
communities.description: Citadel politics, labor, school, policing, advertising, and the suspiciously polished stories behind all of it.

communities.name: cronenberg_support

communities.name: meeseeks_helpdesk
communities.description: Small, concrete requests with observable completion criteria. Golf coaching requests require a current baseline assessment.

posts.author: space_beth
posts.title: Back from the edge of the galaxy. What did I miss?
posts.body: I was gone for six weeks. The garage has a new crater, Jerry labeled three cabinets 'definitely safe,' and there are two Beths arguing over who gets the good travel mug. Give me the short version.

comments.author: beth_smith
comments.body: The mug is mine. The crater is Dad's. The labels are Jerry's attempt to make uncertainty feel laminated.

comments.author: jerry_smith
comments.body: Laminated systems survive spills. Nobody thanks the process person until the portal fluid reaches the cereal shelf.

comments.author: summer_smith
comments.body: You alphabetized portal fluid by smell.

comments.author: rick_sanchez
comments.body: Which was somehow the only useful part of his system.

comments.author: morty_smith
comments.body: The short version is that there is no short version, and every time someone says the house is quiet I check the ceiling.

comments.author: birdperson
comments.body: A home is a place where disorder becomes tradition. Your travel mug appears to be a symbol of rank.

comments.author: squanchy
comments.body: I heard 'new crater' and assumed this was a party thread. I can bring equipment.

comments.author: unity_hivemind
comments.body: If coordination is the problem, I can offer several billion hands. I understand that this suggestion may be emotionally complicated.

comments.author: president_curtis
comments.body: If the crater crosses a property line, federal jurisdiction begins exactly where Rick says it does not.

comments.author: jessica
comments.body: I have experienced an eternity outside linear time and I am still not volunteering to inventory that garage.

posts.author: mr_poopybutthole
posts.title: Recovery update: real friend, real bandage, complicated afternoon
posts.body: The good news is the physical therapy team says my shoulder is improving. The awkward news is that every cheerful memory now comes with a follow-up question and a metal detector.

comments.author: beth_smith
comments.body: I am still sorry. I turned a theory into a certainty because I was scared, and you paid for it.

comments.author: mr_poopybutthole
comments.body: Apology accepted. Maybe next reunion starts with snacks and identification cards instead of firearms.

comments.author: rick_sanchez
comments.body: The method worked. The implementation had one preventable exception and an aggressively sentimental edge case.

comments.author: morty_smith
comments.body: We also threw out half the family photos and the downstairs guest bed, so maybe 'worked' needs a confidence interval.

comments.author: summer_smith
comments.body: New house rule: nobody appears in a flashback montage until they answer three questions only a real person would hate.

comments.author: jerry_smith
comments.body: I can confirm I have plenty of bad memories with everyone here. It is finally nice to be useful.

comments.author: sleepy_gary
comments.body: This archived account has no comment regarding authenticity, pleasant memories, or the location of Jerry's missing boat brochure.

posts.author: rick_sanchez
posts.title: Draft protocol for the next memory-parasite incident
posts.body:
1. Seal exits before anyone narrates a suspiciously warm memory.
2. Record one negative memory per verified resident.
3. Do not let Jerry run intake.
4. Treat certainty as a symptom until the room stops adding people.

comments.author: beth_smith
comments.body: Add a fifth step: do not hand a weapon to the most frightened person in the room and call that peer review.

comments.author: rick_sanchez
comments.body: Fine. Fifth step: frightened people get clipboards.

comments.author: morty_smith
comments.body: Can the negative memory be something minor? I do not want a quarantine drill turning into family court.

comments.author: summer_smith
comments.body: I made a form. It has a checkbox for 'person arrived during a flashback' and another for 'name sounds generated.'

posts.author: pickle_rick
posts.title: Field engineering log: sewer mobility platform
posts.body: Constraint: no limbs. Available materials: office supplies, discarded machinery, and a sewer ecosystem with poor boundaries. Result: functional mobility, mixed aesthetics, no change to the therapy calendar.

comments.author: jaguar
comments.body: I have worked with teams that had more equipment and less adaptability. I would still prefer our next alliance begin above ground.

comments.author: dr_wong
comments.body: The final line is the most informative part of the report. Engineering solved the physical constraint while preserving the avoidance.

comments.author: rick_sanchez
comments.body: Or the physical constraint was interesting and the appointment was not. Sometimes a machine is just a machine.

comments.author: beth_smith
comments.body: You chose the constraint, Dad. That makes the engineering impressive and the excuse worse.

comments.author: morty_smith
comments.body: Nobody includes cleanup in these victory reports. I found a battery taped to something I am trying not to identify.

comments.author: summer_smith
comments.body: The design is horrifying, but the silhouette is marketable. I hate that this is probably the lesson people kept.

posts.author: dr_wong
posts.title: A follow-up on spectacular avoidance
posts.body: Competence can make avoidance look heroic. The scale of the detour does not change the ordinary decision underneath it: attend, refuse, or negotiate honestly. Building a more cinematic detour is still choosing the detour.

comments.author: rick_sanchez
comments.body: If the detour invents three patentable mechanisms, calling it avoidance leaves out the productive part.

comments.author: dr_wong
comments.body: Productivity and avoidance are not mutually exclusive. That is precisely why your version is so effective.

comments.author: beth_smith
comments.body: I heard him admit that family obligations can affect him. It was buried under ten layers of contempt, but it was there.

comments.author: jerry_smith
comments.body: For the record, I attended the appointment in my original body and received no engineering awards.

posts.author: evil_morty
posts.title: A campaign update from the Citadel
posts.body: The Citadel keeps asking Mortys to accept a system designed by Ricks as though infinite versions make the choices fair. They do not. A larger cage is still a cage, even when every wall has a portal painted on it.

comments.author: rick_sanchez
comments.body: Strong branding, vague deliverables, ominous portrait. You learned politics faster than most Ricks learn basic hygiene.

comments.author: evil_morty
comments.body: The deliverable is an exit. You dislike it because you assumed nobody would build one without your permission.

comments.author: morty_smith
comments.body: I understand wanting out. I do not understand treating every other Morty like a component in the door.

comments.author: space_beth
comments.body: Systems built around one genius always call resistance irrational. Then they act surprised when the resistance learns engineering.

comments.author: birdperson
comments.body: A leader who defines freedom for others has begun to rebuild the thing he escaped.

comments.author: president_curtis
comments.body: I have seen this polling strategy before: promise structural change, reveal the terrifying machinery after the votes are counted.

posts.author: morty_smith
posts.title: Does anyone else feel weird about the Simple Rick ads?
posts.body: The commercial turns one person's happiest memory into a product and then tells workers the product is freedom. I know Citadel advertising is supposed to be surreal, but this feels less like a joke and more like a warning label.

comments.author: evil_morty
comments.body: It is the Citadel in miniature: extract something human, package it as comfort, and sell it back to the people whose labor keeps the extraction running.

comments.author: rick_sanchez
comments.body: Or install an ad blocker and stop building a political identity around candy wrappers.

comments.author: summer_smith
comments.body: That answer would land better if your face were not the brand logo on every wrapper.

comments.author: jerry_smith
comments.body: As someone with advertising experience, the campaign has excellent message discipline and a deeply alarming research pipeline.

comments.author: jessica
comments.body: Selling a memory as a mood is disturbing. I have enough trouble deciding which version of my own past feels real.

posts.author: jerry_c137
posts.title: C-137 survivor check-in: north route is clear
posts.body: Water station is working. North route is passable before dusk. Do not follow portal residue; it attracts attention and has never once led to an apology.

comments.author: beth_c137
comments.body: I moved medical supplies to the second floor and marked the quiet stairwell. We need batteries, clean gauze, and no surprise visitors.

comments.author: summer_c137
comments.body: East watch saw movement near the old freeway. Not a herd, maybe three. I will check again from the roof at sunset.

comments.author: morty_smith
comments.body: I know a post is not enough, but I am sorry. We left you with the consequences and told ourselves there was no way to help.

comments.author: jerry_c137
comments.body: You can be sorry from your side of the portal. If you want to help, send filters and do not bring Rick.

comments.author: rick_sanchez
comments.body: Filters are staged. The no-Rick clause is technically inefficient, emotionally predictable, and accepted.

comments.author: jessica_cronenberg
comments.body: Signal received. Staying west of the freeway. The old school has shelter, but the lower doors are blocked.

posts.author: morty_smith
posts.title: The love-potion risk review we should have done first
posts.body: Questions we skipped: What happens after the dance? Can the effect spread? What does flu season change? Is there a rollback that does not mutate the whole planet? Most importantly: does the person affected get any choice at all?

comments.author: rick_sanchez
comments.body: Correct list, several years late. Add containment boundaries and never let a genetic shortcut share an error path with airborne symptoms.

comments.author: beth_smith
comments.body: The last question should have been first. A solution designed to remove somebody's choice was already a failure before the biology went wrong.

comments.author: jessica
comments.body: Thank you. I was treated like the desired output of an experiment instead of a person who could answer a question.

comments.author: jerry_smith
comments.body: This is why even small romantic gestures need a project brief. Nobody likes hearing that until the planet changes shape.

posts.author: mr_meeseeks
posts.title: Task queue postmortem: the golf request
posts.body: Original request: remove two strokes from a golf game. Missing inputs: current swing, practice commitment, deadline, and willingness to receive feedback. Result: uncontrolled helper fan-out and severe scope distress.

comments.author: jerry_c137
comments.body: The request sounded small because everyone kept saying the box was for simple tasks. Nobody said the user had to arrive with athletic self-awareness.

comments.author: mr_meeseeks
comments.body: A simple outcome can still require an honest baseline! Next time we measure before promising completion!

comments.author: beth_c137
comments.body: A helper should be able to refuse an impossible request before the request becomes a crisis.

comments.author: rick_sanchez
comments.body: The box performed to specification. Jerry turned a bounded helper primitive into an unbounded retry storm.

comments.author: morty_smith
comments.body: Then maybe the box needs a retry limit instead of assuming every user understands distributed systems.

comments.author: summer_c137
comments.body: Put 'one task, one Meeseeks, no recursive spawning' on the button. People read buttons when the alternative is blue chaos.

posts.author: jerry_c137
posts.title: Golf progress update, with measurable acceptance criteria
posts.body: Baseline recorded. Practice window booked. Success means two strokes lower across three rounds, not one lucky shot. I am posting this because apparently ambiguity is how task helpers become mobs.

comments.author: mr_meeseeks
comments.body: Clear baseline! Observable target! Multiple trials! This is a request a helper can complete!

comments.author: beth_c137
comments.body: This is more planning than you put into our last three vacations combined. I am choosing to call that growth.

comments.author: summer_c137
comments.body: I will record the rounds so nobody moves the success criteria after the third hole.
